# Step 2.60 — the unofficial-demo notice (lane note)

## Built (commit c5ba9a89)

1. Two league settings in core (`declarations.ts`): `site.notice` (plain text, trimmed, at most 200 characters, '' = none) and `site.doNotIndex` (off to start, protective order so switching it on works in an archived league). Saved by the ordinary `setSetting` command, so they are in the activity log. No migration. Read by `readSiteFacts` (`settings/read-site-facts.ts`, test beside it): a damaged value reads as no notice and do not index.
2. Public pages: one web port `siteFactsOf` (stand-in and database, page snapshot, as no one), read once per request (`apps/web/src/server/league-search-marks.ts`). The league layout draws `SiteNotice` above the header of every public page (an `aside` named "Notice from the league", text only, no close button, wraps at 390). Its `generateMetadata` sets `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow, noarchive, noimageindex">` on every page under such a league. There is no `/find` and no sitemap yet, so nothing to keep the league out of.
3. The children's rule: a youth or mixed league (core's `audience`; an unreadable audience is youth) is always "do not index", whatever its setting (`childrenKeepOutOfSearch`).
4. Admin: League settings, new group "Public site" (`adminSettings.area.site`) beside Privacy, drawn by the generic settings screen. Step 2.125's Profile screen does not exist yet, so the settings sit where the names choice is; they may move there. Messages in `packages/site/src/messages/en/`.

Tests: `read-site-facts.test.ts`, `site-notice.test.ts`; `checkSiteMarks` in `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` walks home, schedule, standings, stats, teams, team pages and a game page for (a) north-valley after the owner saves a notice with markup in it and "do not index" (notice shown escaped, league mark present), (b) harbor-city, youth (marked, no notice), (c) north-valley before and after (neither), then clears both. The harmful-text test types the attack into the notice box and checks it on every north-valley public page (`notice` in FIELDS and `typed`).

## Decisions

- U-18 (pending, "Decided for you"): every public page of a youth or mixed league is "do not index". An adult league with a child recorded in it is NOT covered by the rule (the made-up adult league has one; covering it would take the choice away from every adult league with one teenager). Its admin can switch the setting on. T4 line 95 corrected; P2 §6 and P9 §3 say how it is built.
- T-312 (pending, Agreed (delegated)), record 107: meta robots in the head only. The `X-Robots-Tag` header stays the test copy's alone, because sending it per league would make the proxy read settings on every answer.
- Added two pending decision files (U-18, T-312); the T4 table row count pinned by `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs` was not touched.

## Not verified

- The database port `siteFactsOf` is type-checked only: not run against a real PostgreSQL.
- The notice's look at 390 wide was not looked at in a picture (CSS: `overflow-wrap: anywhere`).
- JSON answers under a league (the game snapshot) carry no robots mark in production.

`npm run check` passed; `npm run typecheck` passed; prettier on changed files clean; vitest over packages/core, packages/site, apps/web: 408 files, 4411 tests passed; `npm run test:web` passed (263 checks); `node tests/browser/harmful-text-test.mjs --no-build` passed (2020 checks); `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs` passed. `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`: 432 passed, 1 failed, `tests/varsity-hosted.test.mjs`, which also fails without this lane's changes (a missing `apps/varsity-hosted/shared/contracts/src/varsity.ts` in the lane folder).

## Fix round (review: three Mediums, the lead's five decisions)

- M1: `respond` (league-api-route.ts) adds `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` to every league JSON answer, after the answer's own headers (snapshot's cache headers kept; unit test `league-api-route.test.ts`; web-shell checks the snapshot, where the test copy's proxy also sets it). T-312 and record 107 corrected.
- M2: U-18 rewritten "Decided for you": every league that holds a child (youth, mixed, or adult with `hasRecordedChild`) is "do not index"; asks the founder whether a youth league may ever switch indexing on. `readSiteFacts` and tests; web-shell walk: north-valley (recorded child) always marked, still-waters (adult, empty) indexable until it asks. T4 line 95, P2 §6, P9 §3 corrected. The "Left" line above is answered.
- M3: `app/[league]/robots-mark.test.ts` fails if any file under a league but its layout names robots. Lows: robots.txt comment, two polish lines.
- GitHub's test-copy check (847f1f4a): Next.js merges the head shallowly, so the league layout's `robots` replaced the root's test-copy mark (`noindex, nofollow`) on every page of a do-not-index league and its not-found pages. `leagueRobots(facts, testCopy)` now adds nothing on the test copy (its own mark stands alone, as before); in production and on this computer the league's mark is the one tag when it asks. Unit test of the merge in `site-notice.test.ts`.
- Checks: test-copy browser test passed (50); `npm run test:web` passed (263); `npm run check`, typecheck, the lane's vitest files passed; merge of build/stage-1 was already up to date.
- Whole browser chain, `--no-build` on one build: all 54 files passed. scoring-plays and scoring-screen take about 5 minutes each, so a chunk of three holding them overran 590 seconds; each passed alone.
